concepts.definition: A specific market segment defined by an audience and a need.
A clear reason to buy from you rather than from competitors.
Price minus product, shipping, payment and other per-order costs, before advertising.
Price divided by contribution margin before advertising: the ROAS at which ads consume the whole margin.

questions.q: A product sells for 50 euros with a contribution margin before ads of 20 euros. What is the break-even ROAS?
Why is demonstrability important for products sold through social ads?
questions.a: The benefit must be visible in a short video or photo to stop people scrolling and convince them.

questions.q: Why must margins in the EU be calculated on the price without VAT?
questions.a: Consumer prices include VAT, which is passed to the tax authority and is not revenue for the seller.
